name: ngtchain
description: Each call spends real NGT from a wallet you fund, within a per-call cap and a session budget you set. Claude Code only.

agent_private_key.title: Agent wallet private key
agent_private_key.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet you fund with NGT or USDC on Base. Claude Code stores it as a secret on this computer. It is not read from an existing environment variable.

max_price.title: Max price per call (NGT)
max_price.description: The most one call may pay in NGT. This cap is what stops a larger payment.

session_budget.title: Session budget (NGT)
session_budget.description: The most this server process may spend in NGT. This budget is what stops further payments.
